en.text: Canarium vitiense is a rainforest tree species, of the plant family Burseraceae, growing naturally in Fiji, the Solomon Islands, Samoa, Tonga, New Guinea, Bismarck Archipelago, Admiralty Islands, Louisiade Archipelago, Torres Strait Islands and in lowland north-eastern Queensland, Australia.

id.text: Canarium vitiense adalah spesies pohon hutan hujan dari keluarga tanaman Burseraceae, yang tumbuh secara alami di Fiji, Kepulauan Solomon, Samoa, Tonga, Nugini, Kepulauan Bismarck, Kepulauan Admiralty, Kepulauan Louisiade, Kepulauan Selat Torres, dan di dataran rendah timur laut Queensland, Australia.
